title: Agenda as gradient columns

techniques.name: One record, four views

contour.label: Contour
contour.note: How hard the gradient field snaps through its middle tone into a contour band, as a multiple of the page’s own.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The per-pixel grain in the gradient field, as a multiple of the page’s own. 0 is a clean blend.

warp.label: Warp
warp.note: How far the noise folds the field back on itself, as a multiple of the page’s own.

type.label: Type size
type.note: Size of every numeral, title and caption, as a multiple of the page’s own. It stops at the page’s own size: any larger and the column titles wrap onto their times.

techniques.implementation: The same seven entries drawn as a planted plot, a route map, a timed agenda and a sphere of addresses. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
